landing.feat_subtitle: All-in-one powerful solution for your Discord Server
landing.f1_desc: Earn XP by chatting and joining voice channels, customize beautiful rank cards, and unlock role rewards automatically.
landing.f2_desc: Protect your server 24/7 against spam, malicious links, bad words, and manage automated punishments easily.
landing.f3_desc: High-quality YouTube music playback, 24/7 Lofi streams, custom playlists, and seamless queue management.
landing.f4_desc: Greet new members with custom welcome banners and assign default user or bot roles automatically.
landing.f5_desc: Allow members to self-assign roles by reacting to customizable interactive embed messages.
landing.f6_desc: Create private support channels for individual members with full transcript logging capabilities.

tos.s2_desc: You agree not to use Zeryn Bot for activities that violate Discord Terms of Service or distribute illegal content.
tos.s3_desc: We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service. Maintenance may be performed without prior notice.
tos.s4_desc: We reserve the right to refuse service or disable the bot on any server in cases of service abuse.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_desc: Zeryn Bot only collects essential data required for core operation, such as Server IDs, Channel IDs, and Guild Settings.
privacy.s2_desc: Collected data is solely used to maintain server configurations, authenticate Dashboard access, and enhance user experience.
privacy.s3_desc: All data is securely stored in our databases. We never sell or share your data with any third parties.
